# Reels Breakdown Template

This template is for analyzing top-performing public Reels from competitor accounts.

## Reel Record

```text

Publish date:
Likes:
Comments:

```

## Suggested Output

A useful Reels breakdown should end with:

- top Reels list
- content theme summary
- hook patterns
- visual format notes
- caption patterns
- suggested content tests
